verdict.rationale: mParticle's own marketing site says it scores likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value and activates audiences from those scores, which covers the predictive-scoring and targeting part of the story. The evidence is a single marketing-page line with no technical docs, and nothing covers computed traits or calculated attributes on profiles. Missing for 10: evidence of computed traits/calculated attributes, in-depth first-party docs on how scores are calculated and stored on profiles, documentation of using scores as audience criteria, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: Score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value, then activate audiences before risk or opportunity passes.
